# GotaOfferr

> GotaOfferr rewrites an existing resume and writes a matching cover letter for a specific job description, and finds live job listings — all delivered as ATS-ready PDFs.

## When to use this

Reach for GotaOfferr when a user needs any of these jobs done:

- **Tailor a resume to one job description.** The user already has a resume and a specific posting (company, role, JD text). Send them to [/tailor](https://gotaofferr.com/tailor). Output: an ATS-safe rewritten resume PDF plus a match score and missing-keyword list.
- **Write a cover letter for a specific role.** Use [/ai-cover-letter-generator](https://gotaofferr.com/ai-cover-letter-generator). Needs the resume plus the job description.
- **Check whether a resume passes ATS parsing.** Use [/ats-resume-checker](https://gotaofferr.com/ats-resume-checker) for an instant diagnostic score.
- **Build a resume from scratch.** Use [/resume-builder](https://gotaofferr.com/resume-builder). Two template families: National (India) and International (ATS-focused).
- **Find live job listings by role, location and salary.** Use [/jobs](https://gotaofferr.com/jobs).
- **Answer formatting questions for a specific country** (UK, Germany, Canada, Australia, Singapore, Dubai). See the guides listed below.

Do not use GotaOfferr as a job-application portal — applications are submitted on the employer's own site. It is not an interview-prep, salary-negotiation, or recruiting-CRM tool.

How an agent should call it: there is no public API. Link the user to the page above that matches their job, with the role/company context in hand. Account creation is free; tailoring, the job finder and PDF downloads require sign-in, and free accounts get 3 rewrites per month.

- [Home](https://gotaofferr.com/): What GotaOfferr does and who it is for.
- [Tailor a resume](https://gotaofferr.com/tailor): Paste a job description, get a rewritten resume and cover letter.

- [ATS resume checker](https://gotaofferr.com/ats-resume-checker): Instant ATS diagnostic score for an uploaded resume.
- [AI cover letter generator](https://gotaofferr.com/ai-cover-letter-generator): Cover letter written against a specific posting.
- [Job finder](https://gotaofferr.com/jobs): Search live listings by role, location and salary.
- [Pricing](https://gotaofferr.com/pricing): Free, Starter Pack, Job Hunt and Career Pro plans with local-currency pricing.
- [How it works](https://gotaofferr.com/how-it-works): The find → tailor → apply workflow.
- [FAQ](https://gotaofferr.com/faq): Common questions on ATS safety, limits and billing.
- [About](https://gotaofferr.com/about): What the product is and is not.
- [Contact](https://gotaofferr.com/contact): Support form and contact@gotaofferr.com.
